## What it is

Using publicly available Airbnb data from Salem’s listings and reviews, this project seeks to analyze the effects of various Airbnb characteristics on the pricing and ratings of an Airbnb. Variables of interest included amenities, “key” words mentioned in the reviews, proximity to Salem landmarks, seasonal patterns, overall market trends, and host characteristics. We used linear regression, multiple linear regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors and natural language processing to address these questions.
